description: librobolectric-nativeruntime.so for Linux aarch64, built from AOSP android12-hostruntime-dev at the source of org.robolectric:nativeruntime-dist-compat 1.0.19, with Skia's x86 code paths so that images match the x86_64 build. Load it with the plugin in robolectric-nativeruntime-linux-aarch64. Unofficial; not affiliated with Google or the Robolectric project.
